input: Bleach and re-grout the kitchen sink area

gold.taskTitle: Bleach and Re-Grout the Kitchen Sink Area
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to clean with bleach and replace or refresh the grout around their kitchen sink area.

questions.title: Is this a tiled backsplash, countertop, or both?
questions.description: Identify exactly which surfaces around the sink need to be bleached and re-grouted.

questions.title: How large is the area that needs re-grouting?
questions.description: Understand the square footage or approximate size to estimate materials and time needed.

questions.title: Is the existing grout cracked, crumbling, or just discolored?
questions.description: Determine the condition of the current grout to decide whether it needs full removal or surface treatment.

questions.title: Have you done any tiling or grouting work before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to tailor the complexity and detail of the plan.

questions.title: Do you already have supplies like grout, bleach, and tools?
questions.description: Find out what materials are on hand versus what needs to be purchased before starting.

questions.title: What color and type of grout is currently installed?
questions.description: Identify the existing grout type (sanded, unsanded, epoxy) and color to ensure a matching replacement.

questions.title: When do you want this project completed by?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe to structure the task plan and allow for grout curing time.
